name: fitcoach-tv-backend
description: Workout generator API for FitCoach TV, powered by Amazon Bedrock (Converse API + tool-based structured output).

scripts.dev: npm run build:coach && tsx watch src/server.ts
scripts.bundle:lambda: npm run build:coach && esbuild src/lambda.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --outfile=dist-lambda/index.mjs --external:@aws-sdk/* && rm -rf dist-lambda/public && cp -r public dist-lambda/public
